task.pr_title: feat(python): Make expressions containing Python UDFs serializable

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This isn't sufficient. `AnonymousFunction` isn't completely serde. I think we should extend the `dyn GetOutput` with a `try_serialize`, like we did for the for input function `dyn SeriesUdf` .


After that we can implement `serde` similarly. The `try_serialize` ensures we still fail client side if we cannot serialize the udf.

evidence.thread_resolution:
stinodego: > `AnonymousFunction` isn't completely serde.

Do you have an example of a UDF that would pass the current serialization but would not deserialize correctly on the server? Then I can test for it. I don't really know what the conditions would be for that to occur.
ritchie46: The function doesn't matter per se. The output dtype matters. So any `map_elements` where you set `return_dtype` will deserialize to the default `GetOutput` impl.
